name: android
title: Android Mockup
description: An SVG mockup of a phone with rounded corners, a small centred front camera and slim side buttons, holding whatever image or looping video you pass in.
use: Showing app screenshots or a demo video on a marketing page or store listing.
avoid: The screen needs to be interactive: this is a flat image or video, not a live app.
a11y: The frame is an SVG with no title or alt, so a screen reader gets no description of the mocked-up screen. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall narrow phone silhouette with heavily rounded corners and a thin light bezel, floating on a black stage. A small dot marks the front camera near the top, and a mountain photo above a sea of clouds fills the screen.
behaves: Static phone frame; only an optional looping video placed in it would move. It does not respond to the pointer or clicks.
customise: Size, image URL and optional video URL are props; the frame and bezel colours come from hardcoded light and dark classes.
weight: light: One inline SVG with a single clipped image; no script or animation loop.
